askedOn.description: where it was asked: on this Mac or a paired iPhone

exchangeID.description: the turn's or remark's own id, a lowercased UUID

materialTitle.description: the title of what was in front

reading.description: the reading that was in front, so the exchange leads back to it

description: One partition, whole, at most 6,000 characters: `They asked: <their words>` (a turn), `<her name> said: <reply>` or `<her name> noticed: <remark>`, then `While reading: <title>`. A turn's Rao Verified record covers their words by byte offset in it, never her reply. Searched by meaning; Thread extracts its graph.

id.description: `exchange-<owner>`, the owner lowercased; the wire group is ambient-<this>
FNV-1a of the owner, lowercased, `|` and the exchange's id; the document's is ambient/<kind>/<this>, the same shape filed or claimed

verified.description: the Rao Verified record, `{record, seal}` (Ambient's AmbientThread/README.md)

title: An exchange: a completed turn or a remark she made unasked, in ambient-exchange-<owner>
